_comment: Shortnames that exist in the Rust item dump but are NOT real conveyor-filterable items (DLC redirect-skins that collapse to a base item, world-only entities, etc.). The import (optimize-diff-items.mjs) never adds these to items.json and removes them if present; the verifier (verify-item-images.mjs) ignores them. Add a shortname here to keep future `items:update` runs from re-introducing it.
